headline: Brent Crude Surges Past $111 Amid Upgraded Oil Price Forecasts
summary: Brent December futures traded up 2.65% at $111.70 after touching $112.68, as Citi sees increased upside risk for oil prices despite recovering Middle Eastern crude exports, reversing its earlier bearish outlook.
why: Crude oil is a vital global commodity influencing energy costs, inflation metrics, and transport sector margins worldwide. Citi is a major global investment bank providing market forecasts.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Upgraded price expectations and supply concerns drive upward momentum in oil futures.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Higher oil prices generally increase revenues and earnings for oil exploration and production companies.

why_moved: Higher oil futures prices were driven by revised analyst outlooks highlighting persistent supply constraints and export bottlenecks in the Persian Gulf.
